(Other signals are accepted if the order of events is clear.) 2. a) kunt bastanna l-utubīs lamma šuft Šarīf. (also: wi ana bastanna l-utubīs, šuft Šarīf.) · b) kān lissa wāṣil mi l-ʾAhira. · c) kunt ḥa-aḫrug (haḫrug), bass id-dinya maṭarit. · d) kān lissa ma-wiṣilš lamma mšīna. ·
e) kunt nāsi l-basbōr f l-bēt. · f) wi ana māši, ḥadd Nadahni.

Exercise 3. a) ya ḫabar abyaḍ! mabrūk! · b) ya ḫabar Iswid! maʿlēš… · c) lā ya šēḫ! · maʿʾūla! · d) wi baʿdēn? ḥaṣal ēh baʿdēn? · e) ʿašān Kida! · f) ḥamdilla ʿa s-salāma! Exercise 4. a) il-mudīr ʾalli inn il-igtimāʿ bukra s-sāʿa tisʿa. · b) Yāsmīn saʾalitni law (iza) kunt fāḍi N-naharda. · c) ʾalitli ma-ansāš Akallimha. · d) ʾalli Astana hina. · e) ʾāl innu miš ḥayiʾdar yīgi. · f) biyʾūlu inn il-mudīr ḥa-yimši. Exercise 5. Personal answer. The tutor controls the five structures (ʾalli Inn saʾalni law · ʾalli aʿmil · ʾalli But...š · ʾultillu) and the absence of inn and bi-in the reported orders. Exercise 6. a) ʾalli inn il-ʾaṭr itʾaḫḫar. · b) saʾalitni Law kunt aʿraf iṭ-ṭarīʾ. · c) ʾalli astannā. · d) biyʾūlu inn il-mudīr ḥa-yistaʾīl. · e) kunt ḥansa l-maʿād. · f) wi fagʾa n-nūr itʾaṭaʿ. Exercise 7. Personal answer. The tutor checks that the signals and entries reported have actually been found in the recording and that the summary uses the past, at least one kunt ba-... and a sentence given. Exercise 8. a) The flight went well. The suitcases came out one after the other, everyone left, the tape stopped and his suitcase didn't come out. The clerk told her the suitcase was still in Cairo and told her to fill out a form and wait for a call. Why Šarīf revealed the end (the suitcase arrived yesterday) and ruined the story, which still had a nice piece b) That the project has been postponed for two months because the customer wants to change the project. He asked him if he could make a new version in two weeks. Don't worry and ask the group for help. He's afraid the client will cancel the contract; Luke is not convinced because they are only voices of office: "They say" is not a source. c) The lady. Suʿād, their old neighbor. That your daughter will also go to Milan to study next month. If the daughter can call to Yāsmīn to ask her about the accommodation and the university. To answer the girl, to eat well and not to be late at night. You look tired. What's wrong? · 16. I just woke up when the phone rang. · 17. And there he was standing at the door! · 18. He told me not to come before 5:00. · 19.
